One tab per PT day; summary on top of each. Spend/sales are cumulative within that day (reset at midnight PT); Δ15m is the increment since the previous snapshot. 30d avg is a normal day's spend (prior-30-day average); vs avg = this day's spend ÷ that average (a Prime Day lift multiple — for the in-progress day it climbs through the day).
Attribution shift (−3h): a pull at clock-time T is labelled T−3h (6:00 → 3:00), since Amazon back-attributes conversions late. Intraday ACOS is provisional and improves as conversions land. Page auto-refreshes every 5 min; your selected tab is remembered.
